title: Pairwise replay report for the default Advisor intent
headline: For the Advisor's default pairwise question, qwen3.7-max and glm-5.1 remain statistically tied. On the workflow-stress proxy slice, qwen is +3.0 pp over glm, but the uncertainty interval crosses zero.
condition: replay,target,p_alt=0.5,pool=8,budget=12,pass^3; filtered to qwen3.7-max vs glm-5.1 and workflow-stress strategy slices

missingness.policy: aggregate fixture from corrected paper experiment; raw per-task eval rows and server/category axes are not embedded in this Studio demo fixture

multiplicity.policy: single pairwise demo claim with exploratory strategy-slice diagnostics
multiplicity.note: The pairwise delta is aggregate-backed. Strategy slices are shown to align the demo with the default workflow intent, not as independently powered confirmatory tests.

allowed_claims: Scoped pairwise comparison for qwen3.7-max vs glm-5.1 on the corrected E8.10d replay data.
On the workflow-stress proxy slice, qwen3.7-max is observed at 99/200 pass^3 and glm-5.1 at 93/200 pass^3.
The observed qwen-minus-glm delta is small and statistically inconclusive under the aggregate approximation.
not_allowed_claims: claim that qwen3.7-max is definitively better than glm-5.1
server-filtered claim over yfinance or finance-tools
claim that the current corpus handoff itself already ran evaluation

issues.message: The available E8.10d JSON artifacts expose model and strategy axes, but not server/category axes.
issues.statistical_reason: A finance-server-specific post-run claim requires per-task metadata or raw eval/spec rows with server/category labels.
repair_options: Convert raw eval/spec rows into an OutcomeTensor with server/category metadata when those rows are available.
Keep this replay card scoped to model and workflow-strategy slices.

provenance.corpus: TokenWasteGroup/DynamicMCPBench cleaned 750-task leaderboard slice; filtered to qwen3.7-max vs glm-5.1 and workflow-stress strategy aggregates
provenance.execution: provider-pinned replay correction after E8.10c diagnosed OpenRouter routing artifact
provenance.server_filter_note: The checked E8.10d JSON artifacts do not contain server/category metadata, so this demo cannot honestly claim a finance-tools/yfinance filter.

data_quality: E8.10d is the authoritative corrected source for qwen3.7-max and glm-5.1.
The report is aligned to the Advisor default pairwise intent by filtering the model axis to qwen3.7-max vs glm-5.1.
The workflow-stress slice is a strategy-axis proxy: long_similar_chain, prerequisite_strict, recovery_required, and cross_server_alt.
A finance/server-specific filter is not available in the checked E8.10d JSON artifacts.
E8.8b is contaminated and retained only as discarded provenance.
